segments.normalizedSource: When you implement accessory delegate methods like [`accessory(_:service:didUpdateValueFor:)`](hmaccessorydelegate/accessory(_:service:didupdatevaluefor:).md), changes made with HAS show up in your app right away as well.
segments.contextBefore: For example, if you let the user switch a light bulb off in your app with a toggle switch, the state of the light bulb changes right away in the HAS interface to match.
